description: Ubuntu 24.04 OpenSSL FIPS provider implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: SSH KDF using AVX2 SHA implementation.

details: Processor Xeon Gold 6226 (processor family X86) from Intel

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
